1091.routing_policy: Existing canonical approach routing/phase model is retained. This repairs admitted internal generation and transit; it does not calibrate native12 turn shares or intermediate SC2 signal delay.
1091.initial_events: Observed source/connector vehicles start inside Omega with no generated/entry/exit event. Only future accepted generation adds stock.
1091.unadmitted_policy: Desired native volume accumulates as explicitly unadmitted demand outside model inventory until the finite existing receiver accepts it. It does not contribute TTT before admission.

demand_transform_contract: The canonical runner reads each original INPX TimeIntVehVol, applies demand_scale times the input role multiplier, overridden by no:<input> when present, and verifies each interval write by readback. This module uses the same pinned roles/profile and checks the live internal-demand aggregate. For the recorded retry, scale1 and urban_input1 preserve1091 volumes112/160/168/144/112/80; individual1091 readback is not separately logged.
scope: Explicit opt-in source-to-existing-origin declaration; no player territory, Ω membership, gate CSV, beta, signal plan or extra storage capacity is changed.
